strategy_roster.name: MA2CCI
strategy_roster.notes: The documented SMA(4)/SMA(8) crossover is joined by a CCI(4) zero cross, which is approximated by the 4-bar z-score since CCI is not in the DSL. The 1-ATR entry stop cannot be encoded as a percent field and the 1-minute timeframe is not available.

strategy_roster.name: Waddah Attar Trend
strategy_roster.notes: The Waddah Attar value is the documented EMA(12)-EMA(26) difference multiplied by an MA(9), and its colour flip is the zero crossing of that product. The documented percent protections StopLossPercent 1.0 and TakeProfitPercent 2.0 are used; the H4 timeframe and TrendMode variants are not represented.

strategy_roster.name: Ultimate Trading Bot
strategy_roster.entry_long: crossabove(rsi(close,14), 30) and close > sma(close,50) and crossabove(macd(close,12,26), macd_signal(close,12,26,9))
strategy_roster.notes: The long-only entry keeps the documented RSI 14/30/70 levels, MA(50) price filter and MACD 12/26/9 cross; the Stochastic(14) cross is dropped because Stochastic is not in the DSL. The docs state no explicit stops, so none are set.

strategy_roster.name: RSI MA on RSI Filling Step
strategy_roster.notes: Implements the documented rule literally: RSI(14) crossing its Simple MA(21) with both on the same side of the MiddleLevel 50. ReverseSignals, the direction Mode filter, position-count flags and the optional session window are configuration and are dropped.

strategy_roster.name: Kijun Sen Robot
strategy_roster.notes: Kijun-sen(12) is the 12-bar Donchian midpoint and the LWMA(20) confirmation is approximated by EMA(20) with the documented 6-pip filter dropped as a price unit. The 07:00-19:00 window, Tenkan/SenkouSpanB periods and the pip-based stop, break-even and trailing logic are not expressible.

strategy_roster.name: Futures Engulfing Candle Size
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > open and high - low > atr(high,low,close,14)
strategy_roster.exit_long: close < open and high - low > atr(high,low,close,14)
strategy_roster.notes: The 25-tick candle-range threshold is replaced by a range larger than ATR(14) (14 is a fallback, no ATR period is documented) with direction from the candle body, as documented. The 07:00-09:15 session window and the 50/40 tick take-profit and stop-loss are tick or time based and are not percent fields.

strategy_roster.name: Sigma Spike Filtered Binned OPR
strategy_roster.notes: The open-position-ratio distribution is not available, so its extreme bin is mapped to a documented 2-sigma spike in 20-bar returns (SigmaSpikeLength 20, SigmaSpikeThreshold 2) and the long leg is the downside spike. OprThreshold 10 has no DSL analogue since the bin histogram is not observable from OHLCV.

strategy_roster.name: Self-Learning Experts
strategy_roster.notes: The learned binary-pattern probability is not observable, so the documented PatternSize 10 upward-move probability is approximated by a 10-bar gain with RSI momentum confirmation. The forgetting factor, optional stop relocation and the trailing stop in price steps are not expressible and no percent stop is documented.

strategy_roster.name: Up Gap Strategy With Delay
strategy_roster.notes: The session up-gap is approximated by an open 1% above the recent average (GapThreshold 1 in unspecified units) and the documented 7-bar holding period by a close below SMA(7). The session-open reference, the delay-period counter and a bar-count timer exit are not available in the DSL.

strategy_roster.name: Higher Order Pivots
strategy_roster.notes: The docs state the strategy is analytical only, detects first/second/third-order pivots for display and places no orders with no entry or exit criteria. Marked non-trading instead of fabricating a pivot signal.
